propositions: The outbound comment dedup key is predicted by separate compositions in the differ and adapter rather than derived from the bytes actually sent, creating convergence drift when the three compositions fall out of sync

The differ builds the key from _normalize_comment_body(codec.to_wire(_decorate_outbound_comment(sanitizer.fit_comment(body)))) but the mutation carries only the un-fitted body, while the transport re-derives the wire independently

Both mutation-enactment consumers (dispatch_one.py create path and dispatch_apply_phases.py update path) must be scoped together to send the fitted wire_body; scoping only one leaves the other sending un-fitted body while the key came from wire_body

The dedup key must be derived from the bytes actually sent by moving fit logic to a new fit_for_send function that returns both landed_text (the marker-stripped decode) and wire_body (the pre-encode fitted text)
The adapter's defensive fit must remain idempotent so re-fitting an already-fitted body returns it byte-identical, preventing the bytes from shifting after the key was taken
